I have to say all the receptionists I have dealt with have been fantastic, they have been really helpful and havent just fobbed me off which they could of done. Today I was on hold for an hour which ok is frustrating, however I dealt with Audrey and what a fantastic woman. She really went above and beyond, she listened to what I had to say and made sure she understood. Its not a straightforward thing we are trying to sort out as its connected to paperwork which involves Durham Council so as you can imagine its never simple. Audrey gave me the number and details of other organisations that might be able to help. She also put a request in to the Doctor although she was honest that she wasn't sure if the Doctor would or could help in this situation as its a difficult one. However she did it and so has taken details and will let us know when theres a response. She was clear and let me know it might take a while to get some news because all though important to us there are other priorities the Doctor deals with, which I completely understand. I really feel this is exceptional re caption work and I wish all the staff were like this in the North West where I live! Honestly Audrey is a credit to the surgery and the other lady I dealt with last week (so sorry I didn't get your name ) have been a real help and gone through all the possible options for me which is genuinely appreciated.
